notes: PAP reference G30/2818. Whole two-room duplex occupying the third and fourth/top floors of a small central Rouen building. The complete advert distinguishes 44.76 m2 of regulated surface from 76 m2 of total floor area; the regulated surface is retained. It describes a large south-facing living room on a quiet courtyard, equipped open kitchen, shower room with laundry area and an upper bedroom/mezzanine with dressing room, exposed brick, beams and roof windows. The seller explicitly states individual electric heating, DPE E and immediate vacancy. Monthly charges are exposed only as an approximate EUR 70-80 range and are therefore not stored as an exact annual amount. The live text contains no lease, occupied-sale, managed-residence or special-sale wording. PAP exposed 9 property photos and a publication date of 24 September 2026. No elevator or other unexposed facts are inferred.
